To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) We propose multiple instance learning models for human action classification in still images, which outperform the state of the art by a significant margin on the challenging ActivityNet dataset, and (2) We demonstrate the utility of specialized person action and object interaction features in the Visual Madlibs task, and show that they improve the accuracy of the VQA models.

(a) deep models can be trained to make human activity predictions in still images with transfer from large-scale image data, (b) the same deep models can be used to extract features for Visual Madlibs question answering, and (c) specialized features can improve performance on Visual Madlibs questions about person activity and person object interactions.

we propose a multiple instance learning model for action recognition that achieves state-of-the-art results on two large-scale datasets, and that we show that specialized features for person-object interaction and action recognition can improve accuracy on Visual Madlib tasks.

the problem of learning visual representations of human activities and person-object relationships, with the goal of improving the accuracy of question answering systems.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we show how to learn specialized features for activity recognition and person-object interactions, and how to transfer these features to the task of answering questions about people and objects.

we show how deep convolutional network features trained on large scale activity and relationship detection datasets can be used for question answering, and how the question answering task can be used to further improve the activity and relationship detection task.
we show the effectiveness of specialized features in improving accuracy on VQA, and that the VQA task is an interesting testbed for learning models that generalize well across multiple datasets.

specialized features can be trained on large-scale datasets of person activities, and then used to improve performance on downstream tasks such as VQA.
